title: Saturday at the Market
text:
Ali goes to the market on Saturday. He buys twenty apples and forty bananas. The market has ninety tomatoes too. Ali is happy with his shopping.

Ayşe goes to the market too. She buys sixty eggs for a cake. Then she meets Ali and they walk home together. They eat the cake at four o'clock.

questions.text: How many apples does Ali buy?
How many eggs does Ayşe buy?
Why does Ayşe buy so many eggs?
options: She wants to bake a cake
She wants to sell them at the market
She is buying them for a bird

questions.text: How do Ali and Ayşe probably feel at four o'clock?

vocabulary.definition: round fruits that are often red or green
a place where people buy food and other goods
oval objects laid by birds, often eaten as food
a sweet food made from flour, sugar and eggs

paragraph_translations: Ali cumartesi günü pazara gider. Yirmi elma ve kırk muz alır. Pazarda da doksan domates var. Ali alışverişinden mutlu.
Ayşe de pazara gider. Pasta için altmış yumurta alır. Sonra Ali ile karşılaşırlar ve birlikte eve yürürler. Saat dörtte pastayı yerler.
